title: use GPUs

mat[is_singular] = t.eye(3).to(device) — the t.eye(3) helper must be moved to GPU to match the operands; this is the gotcha the exercise teaches
raytrace_mesh_video driver still calls t.cuda.empty_cache(); now meaningful because actual GPU memory is being allocated each frame
same Moller-Trumbore as 0_1_6 — the exercise is a wholesale copy of raytrace_mesh with device-management threaded through
same double-repeat for (NR, NT) batch as 0_1_6
t.stack([-D, B - A, C - A], dim=-1) — same as 0_1_6
same det/is_singular/eye-replacement/AND-out pattern as 0_1_5 and 0_1_6, with the eye now device-aware
einops.reduce(s, 'NR NT -> NR', 'min').cpu() — same min reduce, with .cpu() appended
A, B, C = triangles and O, D = rays (post-repeat first-axis unpack); s, u, v = sol.unbind(-1)

notes: 12 atoms — high count because the exercise is raytrace_mesh-plus-device (10 inherited atoms + 2 new device atoms: tensor-to-device, device-consistent-construct).
